message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, with later support from Marshal Ivan Konev and others).
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Paulus), supported by the Luftwaffe and other Axis forces. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, situated on the banks of the **Volga River**. The battle took place in and around the industrial heart of the city, encompassing its factories, rail yards, and the Volga’s strategic crossing points. | The confrontation became one of the deadliest and most pivotal battles of World War II, ultimately turning the tide in favor of the Allies on the Eastern Front.
